title: ToolCapability
description: Normalized detection result for an external tool or PROJECT_NATIVE toolchain (rg, CodeQL, Graphify, OSV-Scanner, TypeScript, ESLint) — produced by lib/tool-capability.mjs's detectTool()/detectProjectNative(). Availability is never inferred from documentation, an adapter existing, or a registry entry: it is set only from a real, executed detection (PATH lookup + --version invocation, or tsconfig/config-file presence for PROJECT_NATIVE tools). Consumer: security-verification-engine.mjs (gates whether a tool may be invoked) and doctor.mjs/self-test reporting.
